name: hipstudio-static

scripts.build:platform: export PLATFORM_URL=${PLATFORM_URL:-https://www.hipstudio.hu}; python3 tools/build_platform.py && python3 tools/enrich_platform_commercial.py && python3 tools/build_platform_solutions.py && python3 tools/enrich_solution_depth.py && python3 tools/build_platform_services.py && python3 tools/build_quote_request.py && python3 tools/build_privacy_pages.py
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:platform
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:platform && npm run test:master-brand && npm run test:domain-migration && npm run test:legacy-url-matrix && npm run test:commercial-content && npm run test:solution-depth && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:business-provider && npm run test:release-gates && npm run test:legal-controller && npm run test:privacy-governance && npm run test:service-inventory && npm run test:public-quote && npm run test:quote-routing && npm run test:pricing

description: HIPStudio master platform for Business, Creative and Flúgos Experiences. hipstudio.hu is served from the HIPSTUDIO repository; flugos.hu is a specialist entry domain pointing to the Flúgos page inside HIPStudio. Privacy governance uses Hipstudió Kft. as controller and Németh Tímea as human contact. Public pricing is suppressed. No automatic production cutover.
